snippet.title: Echo Weaver | Thinky Games Showcase Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184080/Echo_Weaver/?utm_source=agyoutube

Echo Weaver is a time loop metroidbrainia where time is your best resource and secrets are your only upgrades. You're the last of the Weavers, a remnant of a ruined society trapped in a glitching time loop.

Explore what remains. 
Uncover the mystery. 
Perfect the loop.

To learn more about Akupara Games and Moonlight Kids:
►Akupara Games: https://linktr.ee/akuparagames
►Moonlight Kids: https://www.moonlightkids.co/
